title: Show Up
tagline: Onchain RSVP and Event management that allows you to earn $$ by showing up at events!

prizes.placement: 🥇 The Graph — Best New Subgraph or Substream
prizes.title: The Graph

description:
Show Up is an onchain RSVP and Event management protocol. It aligns the incentives between event organizers and attendees. Increasing participation rates by requesting a registration fee for attendees. Active participants get rewarded by splitting the fees from those who didn't show up.

The goals for this project
- Higher event participation for event hosts
- Reward active participation for attendees
- A decentralized, open and permissionless protocol

Earn $$ by showing up!
how_its_made:
The project consist out of 3 main layers

1. Show Up Protocol - Sup 😎👋
- handles deposits, payments and conditions for each event
- uses a modular set of condition modules depending on different use-cases 
Currently supports Ether and ERC20 payments

2. Structured metadata
- stored on IPFS using standardized data formats and App-context
- indexed according format and App-Id using the Graph

3. Show Up, Mobile PWA
- first consumer of the show up protocol
- focus on Events data format

The entire stack is fully decentralized and modular allowing anyone to create and  build out any kind of projects or events that people can register to. The conditions are modular and extensible to facilitate for different needs. E.g. habit tracking, health/fitness challenges, bootcamps, etc.
